description: This Kotlin source file contains utility functions related to network host analysis, specifically identifying loopback and private LAN gateway hosts on Android devices. It includes methods to parse IP addresses, check host characteristics, and identify whether the device is running in an emulator environment.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if a given host string represents a loopback address, including IPv4 and IPv6, considering localhost and emulator addresses.

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Checks if the provided host string refers to a private LAN address or loopback, considering common private IP ranges and hostnames.

methods.name: isAndroidEmulatorRuntime
methods.description: Detects if the current runtime environment appears to be an Android emulator based on Build properties.

methods.name: parseIpv4Address
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into a byte array if valid.

methods.name: isIpv6LiteralChar
methods.description: Checks if a character is valid within an IPv6 literal address.
